cause.why_needed: Qualifying TR on linux/amd64 (87320fbf2): every class's verification refused with near_miss_unresolved rootless_stretch_crosses_identity_domain. A stretch that crosses into the identity domain with its station OUTSIDE it is invisible to the builder's arc index (it forms stretches only around in-domain stations), so the verifier's refusal could never agree with any stored row. near_miss_verifier now discloses it by name (identity_domain_tails, identity_domain_tail_count; reason name unchanged, SR-REASON-ONE-NAME) instead of refusing; a crossing stretch WITH an in-domain station stays refused.
